feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Football regulator to address EFL clubs as quest for deal goes on
articles.summary: The head of English football's watchdog will address the 72 clubs below the top flight on Thursday as the quest for a financial redistribution deal with the Premier League continues.

articles.title: Online gambling group BetGoodwin eyes punt on £80m London float
articles.summary: The father-and-son team who control BetGoodwin, an online sports betting and casino operator, have begun plotting a London stock market listing even as their peers intensify warnings over tax rises in next week's budget.

articles.title: 'I used a meet-and-greet parking service and then came back from my holiday to three fines - what can I do?'
articles.summary: Every Saturday, we help a reader with their consumer issue or personal finance dilemma in our Money Problem series. You can send yours to moneyblog@sky.uk. Today we're taking a look at this one...

articles.title: Inflation comes in higher than expected - so what happens next?
articles.summary: The rate of inflation is up to its highest level this year.

articles.title: Starling Bank founder sold last shares at cut-price £1.7bn valuation
articles.summary: The founder of Starling Bank offloaded her final shares in the digital lender at a valuation less than half the price it was reportedly seeking in its last major secondary share sale.

articles.title: Thames Water creditors secure Labour's Hutton to drive rescue deal
articles.summary: The consortium of Thames Water creditors looking to rescue Britain's largest supplier of its kind has appointed a former senior Labour minister in a bid to help get a deal past government opposition.

articles.title: UK unemployment rate falls to lowest level since July last year
articles.summary: The UK's unemployment rate has fallen to 4.7%, in a set of official figures that will support the case for a Bank of England interest rate hike next month.

articles.title: Apollo among suitors for €7bn spreads giant Flora
articles.summary: A pack of buyout firms will this week submit initial offers for Flora Food Group, the spreads giant behind brands including I Can't Believe It's Not Butter.

articles.title: Former Virgin Atlantic chief to pilot traffic management group Ramudden
articles.summary: The executive who piloted Virgin Atlantic Airways through the COVID-19 pandemic is taking the helm at a major provider of traffic management services in his biggest role since he left Sir Richard Branson's flagship company.
